text: 社保基金会8月1日发布的《基本养老保险基金受托运营年度报告（2025年度）》显示，截至2025年末，基本养老保险基金资产总额35206.99亿元，2025年地方养老基金投资收益额1420.71亿元，投资收益率5.76%。分析人士表示，地方养老基金2025年取得5.76%的投资收益率，延续受托运营以来连续正收益、跑赢保底收益的态势。（上证报）
text_en: The Social Security Fund released its "Basic Pension Insurance Fund Trusteeship Annual Report (2025)" on August 1, showing basic pension insurance fund assets totaled 3.520699 trillion yuan by end-2025, with 2025 local pension fund investment income of 142.071 billion yuan and 5.76% investment return. Analysts say local pension funds achieving 5.76% return in 2025 continues the trend of positive returns and beating guaranteed returns since trusteeship began. (Shanghai Securities News)
